owner: CC (code + proofs + the migration); Akien (the design rulings of 2026-07-30: WATCHME keeps the -ME grammar and means 'emits a probe'; every intention gets a keep-learning step BY DEFAULT and 'none, because X' is the only other legal answer; a verdict artifact is the DEFAULT carriage and not the only one; and the bootstrap-vs-product distinction below, which is his and is load-bearing on the whole design; and the CALLBACK -> PROBE rename, ruled in the same conversation: 'that IS what it does PROGRAMMATICALLY... but what it DOES FUNCTIONALLY is: it's a probe')
intention: A NODE EMITS THE WATCHER THAT MEASURES ITS OWN INTENT. The state `LEARNING` is replaced by the summons `WATCHME`, whose act is to EMIT A PROBE — the immutable worker that gathers data about whether this node's intention actually did what it claimed, in the world, after it rests. Being in the workflow is what obliges the ticket to SPECIFY, at ticketing, everything needed to emit that probe: how it accumulates (the trigger), when it clears (the enough-condition), what rides back (the carrier), where that lands (the nexus), and who consumes it. Default carriage is a verdict artifact written against the ticket's own falsifier — the same schema, validator, deposit door and kick-back routing the build-time verdict already uses — but carriage MAY be something else (a metric accumulating for a consumer orthogonal to this intention) provided the spec names its shape and its consumer. A probe carries NO AUTHORITY: it deposits and it pokes; the back-edge on a failed efficacy verdict is the owner's act (Law 6).
why:
THE FALSIFIER BECOMES EXECUTABLE. Every cast node in this system already carries a falsifier and a horizon — /intent question 5 demands it, /sorted's completeness gate refuses a cast without it, and a PROVED node is described as resting 'still carrying falsifier+horizon'. That field has been PROSE on every ticket since the beginning: written, never fired, never measured. Law 4 says a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy, and until it is it is a tracked debt. This node is the payment. A probe emitted at WATCHME IS the falsifier and horizon written in a form that fires.

WHY THE OLD SHAPE HAS TO GO RATHER THAN BE EXTENDED. `LEARNING` was minted as a terminal state before probes existed as machinery, to stand in for exactly this: a place a node could sit while data about its efficacy accumulated. Probes now exist (cairn/base/probe.py — immutable, trigger-as-open-predicate, carrier-as-open-callable, evaluated where the data is owned). So the state has nothing left to do that the worker does not do better: keeping it would mean the node DWELLS while its watcher runs, which is wrong at the tail — a proved intention's efficacy data can only accumulate AFTER it rests, so a node that waits for it never rests and never gets measured. Emitting instead of becoming lets the node rest at PROVED and the watcher stand. That deletes a state rather than adding one.

WHY LEARNME AS IT STANDS IS THE INVERSION OF THE INTENT. Measured 2026-07-30: code-seam@v1 and skill@v1 both carry LEARNME in `path` with `skippable_summons: ['TICKETME']`, so LEARNME is MANDATORY TO CROSS for every node of both classes — and it carries NO GATE (the build gate fires at PROVEME->forward, the exit gate at ->PROVED). It is the one summons in the path that is forced and unchecked. Akien's rule is the exact inverse: optional to CARRY, mandatory to SATISFY once carried. Under the forced-and-unchecked shape the crossing gets filled with whatever is at hand — on ticket a-node-holds-one-claim (2026-07-29) it was filled with close-bookkeeping (depositing that voyage's own berths), which is not efficacy data at all and involved no accumulation; the node never dwelled. /sail step 8 has quietly redefined LEARNME as 'deposit the learnings at the close', and MAP.md's gloss ('learn *from* me — I am material, harvest me into the trees') reads the node as passive corpus. Akien's reading is active: the node causes learning to occur. Same word, two meanings, and the passive one is what got built.

LEARNING WITHOUT AN OBJECT IS INERT (Akien, 2026-07-30). A bare token in the path cannot state what is being learned, so nothing can check it. The object is forced by structure the way `intention+why.json` forces the why — a WATCHME that cannot name its accumulation is a parse error, not a blank field.

WHY ONE FEEDBACK CONTRACT AND NOT ONE PER THING (Akien: 'We do NOT want to be creating learning contracts for each thing individually'). We already built the general one and had not noticed it was general. cairn/chart/verdict.py carries a schema with teeth (claim / instrument / outcome / evidence per claim; validate_verdict refuses narration, refuses an unattributed verdict, refuses incomplete coverage), a rendering into ANY nexus (verdict_node_parts -> deposit_learning(nexus, content, vector, provenance) — one node per claim, bare, content-hashed), and a return route that is ALREADY PHYSICS (a failed criterion is a kick-back, not a crossing; the exit gate enforces it today). So the standard interface for a question nexus / Stackable Learning Brick is one sentence: it accepts a verdict artifact naming one of its claims, and it emits one. It scales down without a second contract — a thing that is not a whole SLB emits a ONE-CLAIM verdict, and n=1 is not a special case of the schema, the coverage check simply has less to cover.
traces_to: Law 4 — the falsifier is the oldest prose-standing-in-for-physics in the system; this is its enforcement, and CLAUDE.md's rules-awaiting-physics section is supposed to shrink monotonically.
Law 3 — an intention whose efficacy is unmeasured is a hypothesis and must be labeled one. Today every PROVED node is exactly that and nothing says so.
Law 1 — one feedback contract compiled once, not a learning agreement re-derived per component; and the resolver is not spent re-answering 'did that work?' by hand.
Law 6 — a probe is authority-free by construction, which is what lets it stay immutable and shareable; delegated writes go through the owner's gate, never ambiently.

I-learns-its-gates (2026-07-16, founding) — the system learns its gates from evidence. This is that intention at the NODE level; CLAUDE.md's learning-as-a-pattern IOU is the same intention at the COMPONENT level (see distinctions in provenance).

falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a WATCHME crossing is accepted that emitted no armed probe — the gate must check EMISSION (the probe exists, is armed, and carries its trigger, enough-condition, carrier, nexus and consumer), which is the clause that makes 'not optional once present' physics rather than prose. (2) A probe is armed and never fires, and nothing is loud about it — a watcher emitted into a heartbeat nobody runs learns nothing while LOOKING like learning, which is the silent-failure disease wearing our own badge; an unfired watcher past its horizon must surface at a diagnostic surface (Law 7). (3) A ticket carrying WATCHME casts with any part of the spec absent — unspecifiable is never a silent omission: no conceivable efficacy measure is a RED at /sorted's completeness gate (the falsifier is unwritable, so the node is not ready to cast), and specifiable-but-not-yet DROPS A TICKET and carries the IOU. (4) `LEARNING` or `LEARNME` survives anywhere as a LIVE state after the migration — a grep must find them only in history, superseded records and the migration's own record (records of truth are never edited to hide the old shape, Law 7). (5) A probe moves a node's state directly — that is an ambient authority leak (Law 6) and it must be structurally impossible, not merely avoided. (6) A verdict written by a probe cannot pass validate_verdict, or needs a second schema to do so — one contract or the design failed. (7) A node casts with neither a WATCHME nor a recorded 'no keep-learning step, because X'; silence is not a legal answer. (8) The spec's `nexus` or `consumer` cannot name a target outside the toolchain — see the bootstrap distinction; a design that only works when the watched thing is one of our own devices has solved the wrong problem.
horizon: Re-read when: the heartbeat actually fires devices' probes in anger (until then clause (2) is the whole risk surface and this node's watchers are armed into a mechanism whose liveness is itself unmeasured); the FIRST efficacy verdict comes back failed and back-edges a resting node (the return route is the least-exercised half of this design and the only part with no existing physics); the first NON-verdict carriage lands (a metric accumulating for an orthogonal consumer) and shows whether 'name the shape and the consumer' is a sufficient obligation or wants its own schema; and the first ticket that is NOT about building the toolchain carries a WATCHME — that is the measurement that says whether the bootstrap distinction was honored or merely written down.
dependencies:
PIECE (a) — WHERE A COMPILED PROBE BERTHS. RULED BY AKIEN 2026-07-30, and it corrects two wrong turns worth recording so neither is re-taken. FIRST WRONG TURN: cairn/base/probe.py's header justifies class-space FROM A MISAPPLIED WORD — 'because it is DECLARATION, it lives with the device's CODE'. A probe is NOT the declaration. The DECLARATION is the intent, and the intent is on the TICKET; the probe is an EXPRESSION of that intent (when this happens, call this, with this). So the placement argument in that header has nothing under it and must be rewritten with the rest of piece (e). SECOND WRONG TURN (CC's, twice): first placing a per-ticket watcher beside its ticket's component, then collapsing everything into instance-space. Both wrong on the same axis.

THE RULE: A PROBE IS COMPILED INTENT — EXACTLY AS CODE IS COMPILED INTENT — AND IT BERTHS WITH WHAT IT WATCHES, NOT WITH THE TICKET IT WAS COMPILED FROM. So a probe's folder is routinely nowhere near its ticket, and probes CLUSTER BY SUBJECT: a device's time-related watchers share a folder in that device, as do the watchers over one piece of code. Three destinations, chosen by the subject:
  (i) WATCHES THE TOOLS -> IN THE REPO, beside the monitored code, CHECKED IN. Someone who installs this repo needs these to have working tools — they are part of what the tool IS.
  (ii) WATCHES THIS INSTANCE'S RUNTIME, or is a standing ask from this user -> instance-space (Akien's example, fictitious: 'watch for parsimonious and AI appearing close together' -> ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/librarian/probes_for_learning/).
  (iii) WATCHES A DOWNSTREAM PROJECT -> that project's own repo, because that project's ticket workflow lives there (Akien's example: an Acurite weather app built with these tools carries its own probes in its own repo, on our work process) — and ITS user-specific learning points at that user's own runtime path, outside both of our roots entirely.

DELIBERATE EXCEPTION TO LAW 5, recorded so it is not 'fixed' later: intent, voyage and proofs share an address, but a probe is none of the three — it is an INSTRUMENT, and an instrument berths at what it measures. A probe far from its ticket reads as drift and is not.

EXTENDS THE THREE-ROOTS TEST rather than breaking it: CLAUDE.md asks 'does the intention have ONE code address?'. For a compiled probe the question becomes 'what does it WATCH, and where does THAT live?' — same question, different subject.

AND IT ANSWERS THE INSTALL QUESTION, which is the half Akien opened this with: a stranger cloning the repo must get the tool-watching probes as checked-in code that ARMS ITSELF on their host, with none of our work-watchers firing on their box. That makes a shipped probe a HOST-SEAM in shape — a declaration that must apply and verify against a host it has never seen — so it lands on ticket host-seam-installer's known gap (host-seams declare apply/verify as PROSE with no machine-readable `applies-to` field). The two are COUPLED, not sequential.

PIECE (b) — THE CLASS TABLES AND THE GRAMMAR. Mint code-seam@v2 and skill@v2: LEARNME leaves the path, WATCHME may appear ZERO OR MORE times at any position, and a bare `WATCHME` with no spec is refused at parse. This is a NEW VERSION and not a widening of v1 (recorded as CC's read, see provenance): the path itself changes, versions are immutable and version-stamped, and migration-by-find-and-replace is the mechanism MAP.md already names for exactly this. cairn/base/transitions.py's exact-sequence conformance refuses a zero-or-more state today, so the parser is real work. Every at-sea node's string migrates; the migration is journaled, never silent.

PIECE (c) — THE SPEC AND THE EMISSION GATE. The WATCHME spec (trigger, enough-condition, carrier, nexus, consumer) becomes a required structure at ticketing, and the emit chokepoint refuses a forward crossing out of WATCHME unless the probe it names is ARMED — emission, not accumulation. THE DWELL FALLS OUT ELSEWHERE AND IS NOT A SECOND MODE (settled with Akien): a mid-workflow node that must accumulate before continuing dwells because the NEXT summons is gated on data that has not arrived, not because WATCHME holds it. One state, one act — emit.

PIECE (d) — THE FEEDBACK CONTRACT, GENERALIZED. `validate_ref` admits a second provenance form (`falsifier@<ticket-id>`) so a verdict whose criteria come from the ticket's falsifier rather than from a berthed chart validate packet is legal. `nexus` becomes a specified parameter rather than the hardwired `hypothesize`. Carriage beyond a verdict artifact is legal when the spec names its shape and consumer. The return route reuses what exists verbatim: outcome=pass deposits and rests; outcome=fail is a kick-back, which is already how the exit gate routes a failed criterion — the ONLY new part is the rest-state form (a fail must MOVE an already-resting node backward, where today a fail refuses a crossing), and per Law 6 that move is the OWNER's act on reading a failed verdict, with the probe only depositing and poking.

PIECE (e) — THE PROSE THAT MUST MOVE WITH THE PHYSICS, each pairing its write with a recompile-gate poke. intentions-other/I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md lines 95-99 ('LEARNING is a state; a probe is the worker... a node IN LEARNING can SET a probe') — SUPERSEDED, this is the exclusive-and-terminal collision. MAP.md's 'Two rests, both inside the one loop' section — rewritten; there is one rest, and the standing work lives in the probe, which is not a node state at all. /sail step 8 stops being a LEARNME crossing (the close-deposit is bookkeeping the close does, not a summons). /sorted casts the WATCHME spec by default and records 'none, because X' when there isn't one. cairn/base/probe.py's own header carries the superseded sentence and must move with it.

cairn/base/probe.py — the primitive is BUILT and needs no extension: triggers are open predicates (trigger(now, context) -> bool), carriers are open callables ((context) -> dict) merged over a static body, a broken carrier does not swallow the poke. This design adds no primitive; it adds an obligation and a gate.
cairn/chart/verdict.py — validate_verdict / verdict_node_parts / write_verdict, the contract being generalized. Its teeth (18 checks) are the regression surface for piece (d).
cairn/base/transitions.py — the emit chokepoint, where pieces (b) and (c) become physics.

The heartbeat + shim path (cairn/ground_loop, cairn/base/shim.py) — falsifier clause (2) is unmeasurable until a device's probes demonstrably fire on a beat. NOT a blocker for the build; IS a blocker for believing the result.

PIECE (f) — THE VOCABULARY: CALLBACK BECOMES PROBE. RULED BY AKIEN 2026-07-30, folded into this build rather than cast separately, and done FIRST so nothing is built on the old word. HIS FORMULATION: 'that IS what it does PROGRAMMATICALLY... but what it DOES FUNCTIONALLY is: it's a probe.' The rename is not cosmetic — the thing had ALREADY become a probe and the name lagged. We ruled earlier the same day that it carries NO AUTHORITY (it deposits and it pokes; the owner acts), and its own header already describes firing as 'kick off a short-lived process that sends a message to the target's shim, then terminates'. So it is structurally incapable of anything but OBSERVE A CONDITION AND REPORT WHAT IT SAW. 'Probe' names that; 'callback' named the plumbing by which the report is delivered.

WHAT FALLS OUT FOR FREE, which is the tell that the rename is real: (1) piece (a)'s placement rule stops needing an argument — 'a probe berths at what it measures' is self-evident where 'a callback berths at what it measures' required a ruling; the name forces the content, which is the naming stone working as designed. (2) The bad justification in piece (a) cannot even be WRITTEN about a probe ('because it is DECLARATION, it lives with the device's CODE'). (3) 'WATCHME emits a probe' reads as one idea, where 'WATCHME emits a callback' read as a state emitting a function pointer.

SCOPE (a find-and-replace while this node is hours old and nothing is built on it — after the build it would be a migration): cairn/base/probe.py and its class; its three proofs (test_probe.py, test_probe_carry.py, test_probe_crossing.py); cairn/base/shim.py, cairn/bus/bus.py, cairn/base/diagnostic.py, cairn/ground_loop/, cairn/system_rackmount/, cairn/librarian/shim.py, cairn/diagnostic_inspector/; CairnCommons/intentions-other/I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md (the FILE renames too — it is a model source, so the write pokes the recompile gate in the same act); MAP.md; and this ticket, already done at the cast.

THE ONE PLACE THE OLD WORD SURVIVES, deliberately: describing HOW a probe is delivered programmatically, in the implementation's own docstring. The word is not erased from the code's vocabulary — it stops being the name of the concept. Recorded because a later reader finding 'callback' in probe.py must be able to tell a survivor from a straggler.
provenance:
Cast 2026-07-30 through /sorted, at the end of a design conversation Akien opened the morning after ticket a-node-holds-one-claim proved, with 'noce. so what is the role of LEARNME?' — a question about a state I had just crossed without being able to say what it was for. The arc: LEARNME is a data-gathering step (Akien) -> it is optional to APPLY but not optional if the data is needed -> 'LEARNING by itself is meaningless, it must CAUSE learning to occur' -> and since probes now exist as machinery, the state should EMIT one rather than BE one. Ratified stepwise, ending 'i think we're in accord? ... /SORTED'.

FOUR DISTINCTIONS RECORDED AT THE GATE (none of them a collision to resolve; all of them things a future reader will otherwise re-derive):

(1) SUPERSESSION, NOT COLLISION, with the parent's open child. state-machine-physics is live at BUILDME and names 'the LEARNING driver-terminal migration + workflow-migration-by-find-replace' among its remaining children. This node SUPERSEDES that child: the driver-terminal is DISSOLVED rather than built, and the find-and-replace half survives as piece (b). code-seam@v1's own `why` files the same migration against itself and is superseded the same way.

(2) NODE-LEVEL vs COMPONENT-LEVEL LEARNING — a distinction, not a duplication. CLAUDE.md's rules-awaiting-physics carries 'every component's charter answers how does this component learn? — it doesn't, because X is a valid answer; silence is not' (ticket learning-as-a-pattern). That is the COMPONENT's standing answer; WATCHME is the per-NODE instance. They are the same intention at two levels of compilation and will likely converge; recorded so the convergence is a choice later rather than a surprise.

(3) THE VERSION RULING IS CC'S READ, following from a ratified premise. Versions are immutable and version-stamped (MAP.md), and this changes the PATH, so it is v2 — not a widened v1. Flagged because the alternative (rule that widening a fork inside v1 is not a semantic change, since no existing node's crossings become illegal) was put to Akien and not explicitly ruled on. If he rules the other way, piece (b) shrinks and the migration disappears.

(4) THE BOOTSTRAP DISTINCTION — AKIEN'S, 2026-07-30, AND IT CONSTRAINS THE DESIGN RATHER THAN ANNOTATING IT. 'Our first problem is to build our tools. We're using the tools on themselves. But we're designing for a world where we won't be constantly designing the tools — we'll be building products with our tools.' Two consequences the build must honor. FIRST: `nexus` and `consumer` take NO DEFAULT drawn from the toolchain. Every WATCHME cast so far would name one of our own nexi and one of our own devices, which would make a toolchain-shaped assumption invisible until the first product ticket — hence falsifier clause (8), which fails the design if a target outside the toolchain cannot be named. This is also WHY carriage had to be open beyond a verdict artifact (Akien's correction): a metric accumulating for a consumer orthogonal to the intention that spawned it is the PRODUCT-world shape, and a verdict-only contract would have quietly encoded the bootstrap world as the only world. SECOND: a tool watching its own efficacy is circular — it is both the instrument and the subject. We DO want the tools learning as we build them (Akien: 'we do want the tools to be learning as we build them!'), so the answer is not to forbid self-watching but to keep the ground truth OUTSIDE the tool's own opinion: the build's proof, the measured run, the artifact on disk. Kin to the standing cocoon note that ground truth stays the build's proof, not CC's opinion.

Akien's closing frame at the cast: capture the rest durably, then he and CC dive into this one together — so this record is written to be the input to that dive, not a summary of it.
